name: com.washawash/laundry
title: Washawash
description: Laundry pricing, Texas service areas and pickup availability; OAuth for customer tools.

tools.name: get_business_information
tools.description: Get authoritative Washawash business configuration, currency, timezone and demo status.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List currently active services.

tools.name: get_service_locations
tools.description: List published service facilities; do not infer visitor addresses.

tools.name: get_membership_plans
tools.description: List configured membership plans and prices.

tools.name: get_laundry_preferences
tools.description: List available laundry options and charges.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Get a specific active service.

tools.name: search_service_areas
tools.description: Search configured service areas by city name or five-digit ZIP without authentication. Returns matching cities and active service ZIPs, not a city-wide coverage guarantee. Use the customer’s exact ZIP with check_service_area or check_available_pickup_slots for prices and current capacity.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: No authentication required. Check exact ZIP coverage, local rates, available pickup windows with remaining capacity, and associated return commitments. An empty slots list means no window is available. For city-name searches, first use search_service_areas.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: No authentication required. Check exact ZIP coverage, local rates, available pickup windows with remaining capacity, and associated return commitments. An empty slots list means no window is available. For city-name searches, first use search_service_areas.

tools.name: check_available_pickup_slots
tools.description: No authentication required. Check exact ZIP coverage, local rates, available pickup windows with remaining capacity, and associated return commitments. An empty slots list means no window is available. For city-name searches, first use search_service_areas.

tools.name: check_available_delivery_slots
tools.description: No authentication required. Check exact ZIP coverage, local rates, available pickup windows with remaining capacity, and associated return commitments. An empty slots list means no window is available. For city-name searches, first use search_service_areas.

tools.name: get_estimated_turnaround
tools.description: No authentication required. Check exact ZIP coverage, local rates, available pickup windows with remaining capacity, and associated return commitments. An empty slots list means no window is available. For city-name searches, first use search_service_areas.

tools.name: calculate_laundry_quote
tools.description: Calculate an estimate in integer cents. Quantity uses hundredths. Not a reservation or payment.

quantity.description: Hundredths of a pound for pound pricing; whole bag count times 100 for bag pricing; 100 for fixed pricing.

tools.name: get_business_policies
tools.description: Get published service terms, privacy and cancellation policy; missing policy means not configured.

tools.name: get_business_hours
tools.description: Get the published business hours description.

tools.name: get_customer_support_information
tools.description: Get configured support contact details.

tools.name: get_booking_url
tools.description: Get the website booking URL; does not create an order.

tools.name: compare_memberships
tools.description: Compare the configured recurring prices and benefits. No unsupported savings predictions.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated customer profile. Requires OAuth scope profile:read.

tools.name: get_customer_orders
tools.description: Get only the authenticated customer’s orders. Requires OAuth scope orders:read.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Get an owned order, actual status events, price and payment state. A receipt exists only for captured payments. Requires OAuth scope orders:read.

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.description: Get an owned order, actual status events, price and payment state. A receipt exists only for captured payments. Requires OAuth scope orders:read.

tools.name: get_order_receipt
tools.description: Get an owned order, actual status events, price and payment state. A receipt exists only for captured payments. Requires OAuth scope orders:read.

tools.name: create_order_draft
tools.description: Reserve a priced draft for ten minutes. Show the customer the quote, pickup and cancellation terms before confirmation. This changes capacity but does not charge. Requires OAuth scope orders:write.

quantity.description: Hundredths of a pound for pound pricing; whole bag count times 100 for bag pricing; 100 for fixed pricing.

estimated_weight.description: Estimated weight in hundredths of a pound, required for bag or fixed pricing to reserve capacity.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Confirm ONLY after the customer explicitly approves the displayed booking and maximum authorization. May return a Stripe-hosted checkout URL; never collect card details. Requires OAuth scope orders:write.

tools.name: reschedule_pickup
tools.description: Change an owned pickup only after explicit approval of the new window. Existing driver assignment resets. Requires OAuth scope orders:write.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible owned order after explicit customer approval and release uncaptured payment authorization. Requires OAuth scope orders:write.

tools.name: get_customer_membership
tools.description: Get the customer’s current active membership. Requires OAuth scope memberships:read.

tools.name: create_membership_checkout
tools.description: Create a hosted recurring subscription checkout after the customer approves the chosen plan and billing cycle. Requires OAuth scope memberships:write.

tools.name: get_saved_addresses
tools.description: Get only the authenticated customer’s saved addresses. Requires OAuth scope profile:read.

tools.name: get_laundry_preferences_for_customer
tools.description: Get the authenticated customer’s saved care preferences. Requires OAuth scope profile:read.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Create a support ticket after the customer approves its contents. Requires OAuth scope support:write.
